rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when talking about something from a business point of view.

example.traditional: 生意上，呢個做法係行得通嘅。
example.jyutping: saang1 ji3 soeng6 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hai6 haang4 dak1 tung1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the more formal or explicitly commercial sense, especially in business or written contexts.

example.english: Commercially, this product still has room for development.
example.traditional: 商業上，呢項產品仍然有發展空間。
example.jyutping: soeng1 jip6 soeng6 nei1 hong6 caan2 ban2 jing4 jin4 jau5 faat3 zin2 hung1 gaan1
